name: Gibson
summary:
A guitar lesson app that uses real guitar and listens to your play, then scores your performance.

Game has weekly leagues for XP and a Hall of Fame for XP.

Extremely fun game to learn guitar includes digital amp with guitar tones.

World wide instructors with inspiring videos included in game.

The app fosters a community of guitar students with in game forum.
